identification: 'Cupid Awake', the 1897 sepia photographic print by M. B. (Morris Burke) Parkinson (companion to 'Cupid Asleep'), a very common Victorian/Edwardian print, here in a round turned timber frame about 14 cm diameter with glass, on a perspex stand. Print may be an original c1897-1900s or a later reproduction (cannot tell from photos). Pencil number '5463/10' on a label (seller's stock number).
